datasets.title: Coastal Flood
datasets.description: Probabilistic modelling of coastal flood hazard
datasets.purpose: To assess coastal flood extent and depth under various extreme event scenarios and sea level rise projections from 2030 to 2150 to support coastal risk management and adaptation planning.
datasets.details: Flood maps showing the maximum flood extent and depth for different extreme scenarios (1-year, 100-year, and 1000-year return period TWL events), various relative SLR projections (decadal time steps from 2030 to 2150 relative to the reference period 1995–2014 for three SSP scenarios and one high-end scenario), and the combination of each extreme scenario with every sea level rise scenario.

resources.title: CFH High Defended – 1-year RP, No Scenario, 2010
